sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Remote Desktop Access and Unattended Machine Telemetry Software

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: France (unitary national jurisdiction; single national company register RNE; no sub-state corporate regime)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic Code tradition; unified commercial code with no state-level corporate law divergence)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–China Agreement on the Mutual Encouragement and Protection of Investments (1984; in force, supersession by the EU–China CAI pending ratification)
EU–China Comprehensive Agreement on Investment (CAI, signed 30 December 2020; not yet in force)
France–Hong Kong Investment Protection Agreement (2021; concluded; not yet in force)
France–China Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (1984, as amended by the 2013 Protocol; in force)
OECD Multilateral Convention to Implement Tax Treaty Related Measures (MLI / BEPS convention; in force for France)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code de commerce, Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL constitution and management), L.123-1 et seq. (RCS registration); Ordonnance n°2023-393 du 24 mai 2023 and Décret n°2021-1622 du 10 décembre 2021 (RNE Guichet unique); Code monétaire et financier (CMF), Articles L.561-1 to L.561-59 (AML/CFT obligations) and Articles L.561-45 to L.561-50 (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs 'RBE'); Décret n°2017-1094 du 11 juin 2017 (RBE declaration); Code civil, Articles 1832-1844 (general company law); Loi n°2024-364 du 22 avril 2024 (anti-fraud and enhanced compliance measures); EU Directives (EU) 2015/849 and (EU) 2018/843 as transposed; FATF Recommendations as implemented.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (restricted register). The French RBE is filed with the RNE but general public access has been suspended following the CJEU judgments of 22 November 2022 (C-37/20 W-M and C-601/20 Sovim SA). Access is now restricted to competent authorities, obliged entities under CMF Article L.561-10, journalists, and qualified civil-society researchers demonstrating a legitimate interest, subject to the conditions of Loi n°2024-364.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport or national identity card of each non-resident UBO and designated gérant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport or identity authority of the UBO's country of nationality; copy certified by a notary or issuing public body
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (HCCH 1961 Convention) where the issuing State is a Contracting Party; otherwise consular legalization at the competent French Embassy or Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residence / proof of address (utility bill or bank statement dated within three months) for each non-resident UBO and gérant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed credit institution in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization in accordance with the issuing State's HCCH 1961 status

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation / company register extract of any corporate shareholder in the ownership chain above the 25% UBO threshold
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry (Registrar of Companies or Commercial Registry) of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; accompanied by a certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good conduct / criminal record extract (or equivalent casier judiciaire document) for the designated gérant where resident outside France
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police or judicial records authority of the gérant's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; certified French translation required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, UBOs, and gérants against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the EU Council consolidated financial sanctions lists under Regulations (EU) 269/2014 and (EU) 833/2014 as amended, and the French national asset-freezing list maintained by the Ministère de l'Économie et des Finances. Politically Exposed Person (PEP) determination is required under CMF Article L.561-10 and FATF Recommendation 12, with enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds and source-of-wealth verification where any PEP, high-risk jurisdiction, or adverse media indicator is identified. All screening results must be documented in a written client-acceptance file (dossier de connaissance client) retained for five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (Guichet unique operated by the INPI on behalf of the Registre National des Entreprises 'RNE'); name availability also verified against data.inpi.fr (trademarks) and the Infogreffe RCS database
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Latin script in the RNE filing; non-Latin names (e.g., Cyrillic, CJK) must be transliterated into Latin characters and filed with a French-language transliteration. The corporate-form suffix 'SARL' or 'Société à Responsabilité Limitée' is mandatory. The name must not create objective confusion with prior RNE-registered entities, prior trademarks, or public institutions, and must comply with Article R.123-25 Code de commerce and Article L.711-4 Code de la propriété intellectuelle. Names must be lawful and not contrary to public order or bonnes mœurs.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banque / Caisse — requires prior authorisation of the ACPR (banking monopoly protection)
Assurance / Assurances / Mutuelle — reserved to regulated insurance and mutual entities
Fiduciaire / Fiducie — subject to regulated fiduciary licensing
Ministère / Gouvernement / République / État — reserved or misleading public-authority connotation
Préfecture / Mairie / Consulat / Poste / Police — reserved to public bodies
Chambre de Commerce / Ordre — misleading professional-body connotation
France / Paris / National — sensitive tokens requiring justification of territorial neutrality and non-misleading use
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not operate a statutory pre-filing name-reservation registry; the intended name is protected only upon RNE registration. If the RNE rejects the declaration or the name, the applicant is notified in writing through the Guichet unique portal. Step 1: within 15 days, refile the declaration with a corrected name eliminating the objection (or submit a formal rectification of the filed elements). Step 2: if the INPI/RNE upholds rejection, file a gracieux reconsideration request with the RNE review unit within two months. Step 3: lodge a judicial appeal before the tribunal judiciaire (or tribunal de commerce where applicable) of the registered office's area, or an urgent référé, contesting the refusal for abuse of power or ultra vires under Articles L.123-33 and L.123-35 Code de commerce. Parallel remedy: pre-emptive or corrective trademark filing with INPI to protect the adopted name at national level.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible and market-standard for ISIC 6201 remote-software and telemetry activities. Commercial domiciliation via a licensed domiciliation company (société de domiciliation) is lawful under Article L.123-11-3 Code de commerce, provided a written domiciliation contract is in place, the address is situated in France, the annual municipal declaration is lodged, and the registered office can receive official mail. Remote screen-share and unattended-machine telemetry software vendors with no client reception or retail footfall qualify without derogation.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low quantified risk; approximately 5-10% annual probability of unannounced on-site inspection for a low-AML-risk ISIC 6201 software SARL. Inspections are triggered primarily by VAT or CFE (cotisation foncière des entreprises) filing anomalies, anti-fraud operations under Loi n°2024-364, or municipal verification of the domiciled address, rather than routine AML controls. No systematic sector-wide inspection protocol applies to software publishers.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal drafting of the Articles of Association (statuts) with ISIC 6201 remote-access software social object, gérant appointment, and RNE-compliant clauses
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External counsel (avocat or licensed legal-tech provider) — fees payable to the attorney's client account
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a standard 1-3 shareholder cash-capital SARL; range EUR 600-1,200 converted at EUR/USD 1.08-1.10

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability and trademark clearance search (RNE Infogreffe and INPI data.inpi.fr) covering software-related Nice classes 9, 38, and 42
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Trademark and company search provider (public INPI search tool is free of charge)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market tariff for a single-name multi-class professional search; EUR 70-140

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the incorporation notice (annonce légale) in a legal announcements journal (JAL) of the registered-office department
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: JAL publisher (publication tariff capped by ministerial order)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per published line; average EUR 120-150 per notice

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified French translation of foreign UBO and shareholder documents (passports, proof of address, corporate register extracts) — estimated for three documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate of EUR 60-100 per source page; estimate for three bilingual certified documents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille or consular legalization authentication for three foreign UBO and corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority of the issuing country; for non-HCCH 1961 States, the French Embassy or Consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed public fees per instrument under the issuing authorities' schedules; approximately USD 35-55 per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT enhanced due-diligence dossier: PEP, OFAC SDN, UN Security Council, EU consolidated, and French national sanctions screening of UBOs, shareholders, and gérants
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed compliance and KYC screening provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for a low-risk-tier single-entity dossier; USD 150-350

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Business domiciliation (virtual registered office) — first-year setup, annual fee, postal handling, and municipal declaration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Domiciliation company (société de domiciliation) regulated under Article L.123-11-3 Code de commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of EUR 650-900 per year in Paris and mid-tier cities; optional meeting-room services excluded

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RNE / Guichet unique creation declaration (déclaration de création d'entreprise) with attachment of UBO declaration and domiciliation documentation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutorily free of charge; no filing tax under current French law

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank account opening in a French licensed credit institution for capital deposit and initial operations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French credit institution (commonly BNP Paribas, Société Générale, Crédit Agricole, or licensed neobank) — subject to AML/KYC acceptance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No setup charge under prevailing market practice for standard professional accounts; monthly maintenance fees excluded

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commissaire aux apports valuation report — applicable only if in-kind contributions exceed EUR 7,500 or 50% of stated capital; not triggered by a cash-only capital structure
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Independent statutory appraiser (commissaire aux apports) appointed by court or by unanimous shareholders
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Not applicable for cash capital; statutory-going rate of USD 400-900 if triggered

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL), L.210-6 (legal personality), R.123-1 et seq. (RCS registration); Décret no. 2021-1738 relating to the Guichet Unique.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry) of the department of the registered office; electronic intake through the Guichet Unique operated by INPI (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de création d'entreprise (formulaire M0) with annexed signed Statuts, capital deposit certificate, legal notice receipt and domiciliation proof; registered at the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a SARL (capital is set freely in the Statuts). Cash contributions must be deposited in a blocked account with a French credit institution or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations and released only upon RCS registration; in-kind contributions require a commissaire aux apports report and are fully paid at subscription. A legal reserve of 10% of the capital is mandatory.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The Shareholders of [Company Name] SARL, convened at the constitutive general meeting, hereby resolve: 1. Share Subscription: Unanimously approve the subscription of [number] shares by the founding shareholders; the share capital is fixed at €[X], divided into [number] shares of €[Y] each, fully paid-up in cash. 2. Registered Office: Adopt the registered office located at [address], within the jurisdiction of the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce du [Court]. 3. Officer Appointment: Appoint [Full Name] as Gérant (Manager) for an indefinite term with the powers granted by the Articles of Association. 4. Formalization: Authorize the Gérant and each shareholder to sign and file the constitutive deeds, the M0 declaration, and any documents before the competent registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Articles of Association (Statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders; optional notaire (notary public) for authentic form
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Statuts in French, setting the corporate form (SARL), corporate name, registered office, corporate object limited to software publishing, remote desktop access, unattended machine telemetry and IoT services; state the share capital, value and allotment of each share, contributions in cash or in kind, gérant appointment and powers. Have every shareholder sign each original and counterfoil; the gérant signs the declaration of appointment. In-kind contributions exceeding a statutory threshold require a commissaire aux apports report.
required_dossiers: Valid passport or national ID of each shareholder
Proof of residential address (utilities bill dated within 3 months)
Non-conviction declaration (déclaration sur l'honneur) of the gérant
Commercial lease or professional domiciliation contract for the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry or the notaire queries the corporate object or statutory clauses, the shareholders adopt an executing resolution and sign an avenant (amending instrument) to the Statuts before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French credit institution or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a 'compte de blocage' (temporary blocked account) in the proposed company name; deposit the total cash subscription; obtain the 'certificat du dépositaire' signed by the depositary bank mentioning the company name, the capital amount received and the deposit date. The funds remain unavailable until the company is registered with the RCS and may only be withdrawn by the gérant after registration.
required_dossiers: Draft Statuts (for bank file)
Identity papers of the shareholder making the payment
Bank account opening questionnaire (mandatory French banking forms)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the deposit, re-route the deposit to another credit institution or to the CDC; if the certificate contains an error, request an amended certificate from the depositary within 48 hours.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the Constitutive Legal Notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'annonces légales (JAL) authorized by the prefecture of the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and submit the legal notice (avis de constitution) to an authorized JAL including company name, legal form (SARL), share capital, registered office address, corporate object, duration, planned RCS registration location and the capital deposit reference. After publication, collect the 'justificatif de parution' (publication certificate) to attach to the M0 filing.
required_dossiers: Final version of the Statuts
Capital deposit certificate
Identity of the gérant for statutory mention
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL rejects the notice due to inconsistent statutory wording, the company delivers a rectified notice approved by the shareholders and republishes it in the same or another authorized JAL.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of the M0 Dossier through the Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises operated by INPI (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Connect to formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr, select 'création d'entreprise' and the SARL legal form; complete the M0 electronic declaration in French; upload the signed Statuts, certificat du dépositaire, publication receipt, non-conviction declaration, registered office domiciliation proof, and identity documents; submit and retain the dossier acknowledgment with a unique filing reference. Track online the transmission to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce.
required_dossiers: Signed Statuts (PDF)
Certificat du dépositaire (capital blocking certificate)
Justificatif de parution (JAL publication receipt)
Justificatif de domiciliation (lease, bail or domiciliation contract)
Déclaration sur l'honneur (non-conviction) of the gérant
Valid passport or national ID of the gérant
Gérant appointment clause extracted from the Statuts
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the dossier is deemed incomplete, the Guichet Unique notifies a deficiency; the applicant has 15 days to upload the missing documents. In case of rejection, correct the inconsistencies, re-submit electronically, or present the completed dossier in person at the Greffe.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS Registration and Issuance of the Kbis Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce having territorial jurisdiction over the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon validation of the M0 dossier, the Greffe allocates the SIREN (company number) and SIRET (establishment number), records the company at the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés, and issues the official 'extrait Kbis' certificate confirming legal existence, the APE/NAF code and any EORI link where applicable; the state filing fee is collected at this stage. The gérant may then release the blocked capital for business operations.
required_dossiers: M0 declaration acknowledged by the Guichet Unique
Receipt of payment of the registration fee
All annexes transmitted in steps 1 to 4
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe issues a query or refuses registration, submit a written explanatory note with an amended avenant to the Statuts; if the refusal persists, refer the matter to the judge in charge of registry supervision (juge commis à la surveillance du registre).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for ISIC 6201 (software publishing and remote support services); Direction Régionale de l'Économie, de l'Emploi, du Travail et des Solidarités (DREETS) is only responsible for inspection of service-sector working conditions, not for any industrial permit.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required - the M0/RCS registration constitutes the sole administrative authorization for a pure software activity; no préfectoral operating permission or professional certification is mandated for remote desktop access and telemetry software.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) - Ministry of Ecological Transition; where physical office premises exist, compliance with the Environmental Code is verified locally by the municipal authorities.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - the activity falls outside the ICPE (Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement) nomenclature, and no full EIA registration or authorization is required for a software/remote-telemetry service without industrial installations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for industrial discharges, VOC, or process wastewater. Office waste handling must comply with local municipal waste sorting and the general obligations of Articles L.541-1 et seq. of the French Environmental Code, including end-of-life electronic equipment sent through certified waste treatment streams.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: For the ordinary office lease, the premises must carry a technical completeness certificate from the landlord; office workplaces are subject to fire safety rules of the Code du travail (Articles R.4216-1 et seq.) and, if open to the public, to 5th-category ERP safety checks by the communal fire commission; an annual workplace inspection by the occupational health service (service de santé au travail) is required once staff are hired, and electrical installations must be verified regularly with an electrical inspection certificate kept at the premises.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFIP) — French national tax administration; electronic filing and taxpayer portal at impots.gouv.fr (Espace Professionnel); business formalities portal operated by INPI: formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; customs documentation portal: douane.gouv.fr.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned French SARL must first complete legal incorporation via the INPI Guichet Unique, obtaining SIREN, SIRET and NAF/APE codification within approximately 5 business days. The DGFIP then automatically attributes the intra-Community VAT number (numéro de TVA intracommunautaire) for established companies; if not assigned automatically, the SARL files Form CEI or activates the VAT identity module in the Impôt Professional online portal. EORI activation (n° EORI FR + SIREN) on the French Customs EORI portal is required for cross-border goods operations. A non-established foreign operator supplying taxable remote digital services in France must register with the DGFIP under Article 286 CGI and, if outside the EU, appoint a fiscal representative (représentant fiscal) jointly liable for VAT under Articles 289-A and 289-I CGI; an established SARL does not require a fiscal representative.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — a commercial SARL is by default taxed as a corporation with full legal personality, subject to Impôt sur les Sociétés (IS) on its French and effectively French-source income, with a standard IS rate of 25% (reduced rates apply to small profits) and a 15% reduced rate on the first €42,500 of taxable profit for eligible SMEs; the SARL is fiscally transparent only if a valid family SARL election (IR) is made; territorial scope: French-resident companies are taxed on worldwide income from their French operations (subject to CbC and PE rules for foreign branches); new SARLs cannot elect pass-through treatment except for SARL de famille or SARL d'exercice libéral under the CGI.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: France does not operate a US-style check-the-box regime. Available elections include: (1) option for IS by otherwise transparency-eligible entities under CGI Articles 206 and 239; (2) IR election for SARL de famille under Article 239 bis AA where all quota holders are natural persons of the same family group; (3) fiscal integration (intégration fiscale) election under Articles 223 A/B for a French parent holding at least 95% of a French subsidiary, enabling group-wide loss offset and dividend elimination; (4) mandatory ATAD hybrid-mismatch constraints under Articles 209B and 212 bis CGI, which are not elective design tools but require documentation of reverse-hybrid and double-deduction avoidance; (5) transfer-pricing filing and CbC report designations where the group exceeds the €750 million consolidated revenue threshold.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée — TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Non-resident suppliers of French-taxable remote digital/IoT services have zero registration threshold and must register from the first euro. A French-established SARL may rely on the VAT franchise en base exemption: for services (relevant to ISIC 6201 remote support software) the base threshold is €37,500 for 2024 and €39,100 from 1 January 2025, with a tolerance threshold of €41,000 (2024) and €43,100 (2025); for goods the base thresholds are €85,000 (2024) and €91,900 (2025), with tolerance at €93,500 (2024) and €101,000 (2025). The franchise is lost if either threshold is exceeded, in which case VAT registration at the ordinary 20% rate becomes compulsory. Intra-EU cross-border B2C digital-services or distance-selling turnover up to €10,000 may be reported via the OSS election without direct French registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory structured e-invoicing for all French domestic B2B transactions under the Y-clearance model: factur-X (PEPPOL BIS 3.02 / UBL or CII) invoices must be exchanged through a certified partner dematerialization platform (Plateforme de Dématérialisation Partenaire — PDP) connected to the Portail Public de Facturation (PPF); mandatory timeline: large enterprises from 1 September 2026, SMEs and micro-enterprises from 1 September 2027; domestic B2C transactions (typical for remote-screen-share subscriptions) are subject to e-reporting of transaction and payment data to the PPF via PDP APIs. This is a data-clearance/audit schema, not an invoice-by-invoice real-time fiscal stamping system; there is no Annex-style state-issued stamp. Cross-border B2C supplies can be declared through the French OSS quarterly return (guichet unique TVA on impots.gouv.fr) with a one-time unlimited election. Non-compliance penalties are €15 per invoice, capped at €15,000 per calendar year, plus VAT reassessment exposure and denial of deduction rights.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Physical goods exports outside the EU qualify for French zero-rating under CGI Article 262-I provided the goods are dispatched outside the EU within 3 months and the exporter holds the statutory evidence (transport, delivery to an independent third party abroad, and absence of French transformation). Intra-EU B2B dispatches are zero-rated when the customer supplies a valid EU VAT number and the goods are listed in the monthly DEB recapitulative statement; services of remote screen-sharing and IoT telemetry software (ISIC 6201) supplied to a non-French established business customer are outside the scope of French VAT ('hors champ TVA') under the Article 259 A-1 B2B place-of-supply rule, which equates to an export zero-ratified position; B2C remote digital services fall outside French VAT when the customer's habitual residence is outside the EU under Article 259 D CGI. Exporters may recover input VAT on export costs (including hardware delivered abroad and foreign distribution costs) under Article 271 CGI, exercising the monthly export VAT-credit refund route rather than the normal quarterly cycle, using the Cerfa 3559 refund request form and supporting export evidence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAU / Déclaration en Douane) accepted by French Customs under export code 10 or 11 with a valid MRN
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill / CMR transport document naming the foreign consignee and establishing EU exit of the goods
Commercial invoice and packing list with Incoterms and export valuation
International Transaction Annex (ITA) or six-copy export invoice set where applicable
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT MT103 bank evidence showing the export proceeds have been repatriated to France within 180 days
Intra-EU transfer documents: VIES-validated customer VAT number and the monthly recapitulative statement (DEB) filed by day 10

Service export substantiation: the underlying service contract, remote-delivery system logs, technical acceptance by the non-French client, and an attestation of effective use and benefit outside France for remote-screen-share/IoT telemetry services
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGFIP export-audit teams under the BOI-TVA-EXP doctrine require full export substantiation within 30 days of a formal audit request; failure to produce the documentation triggers automatic re-instatement of VAT at 20%, with 0.20% monthly late interest, a 5% statutory increase for late payment, and a 40% bad-faith penalty under Article 1729(b) or 80% penalty for abusive/maneuver conduct under Article 1729(a). Fraudulent zero-rating or refund claims additionally expose the company and its management to criminal tax prosecution under Article 1741 CGI, with penalties of up to €3,000,000 and 7 years' imprisonment in aggravated cases, asset seizure, court-ordered publication of the conviction, tax injunction orders, and joint civil liability of directors; the DGFIP also coordinates with the French Customs anti-fraud taskforce and EU OLAF on carousel-style VAT fraud involving cross-border digital services, retrospectively clawing back input VAT credits and interest.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (central bank), acting jointly with the Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury) and the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) under the Code monétaire et financier, Articles L151-1 to L165-1 and R151-1 to R165-1.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility. The Euro is legal tender; France applies the EU Treaty free movement of capital (TFEU Articles 63-66) with no general licensing for current or capital account transactions. Inbound direct investment into the new SARL requires no prior authorisation (the foreign-investment screening decree of 2019-1590 only applies to sensitive defence/security or critical-infrastructure sectors and is not expected to capture ISIC 6201 remote-software activities). Profit and dividend remittances are unrestricted from an FX standpoint; only statistical balance-of-payments reporting (Banque de France 'liaison financière' declarations for transactions ≥ EUR 15,000) and standard French dividend withholding tax (default 25% for corporate recipients or 30% for individuals, treaty relief available) apply.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. France imposes no mandatory surrender of export proceeds, no minimum conversion ratios, and no repatriation deadlines. Foreign-currency receipts may be retained in an authorised foreign-currency account (compte en devises) at an ACPR-licensed bank. The SARL must only comply with the monthly financial-relations declaration to Banque de France when an individual cross-border transfer, or cumulative transfers to the same non-resident counterparty in a calendar month, reaches EUR 15,000.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (compte bloqué) and Operational Account (compte courant)
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High for operational settlement accounts: ACPR-licensed or EU-passported EMIs (Qonto, Shine, Revolut Business, Wise Business, N26 Business) can onboard a low-risk SaaS SARL fully remotely. Legal constraints: (i) EMIs do not hold client funds as classic deposits and are not covered by the Fonds de Garantie des Dépôts et de Résolution, so funds are safeguarded subject to a higher unsecured credit risk; (ii) the SARL constitution capital block must be deposited with an ACPR-licensed credit institution, a notary, or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, meaning an EMI cannot issue the required attestation de dépôt des fonds for the registration block; (iii) offshore non-EEA digital EMIs without an EU banking licence or ACPR passport are not viable for the French registered entity.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote opening is permitted. French AML law (Articles R561-5-1 and R561-5-2 CMF) allows non-face-to-face identification via eIDAS-qualified electronic identification or video verification, and a face-to-face interview is not statutorily mandatory for a low-risk standard legal entity. In practice, Tier-1 banks commonly impose an internal-policy requirement of a physical or video interview of the gérant (manager) and a notarised and apostilled KYC pack when beneficial owners are non-resident; a physical visit to a French branch may be required by bank policy even though remote opening is legally available.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly incorporated SARL with non-resident beneficial owners, no tax track record, and zero operating history.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Kbis extract, Articles of Association (statuts) with amendments, Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE) filing, certified passports and proof of address for the gérant and all shareholders, source-of-funds bank statements or disposal deeds supporting the capital injection, signed AML questionnaire, and a preliminary business plan.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity, low-ticket recurring digital revenue flowing through Stripe and Paddle (Merchant of Record) creating daily cross-border credit streams.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial agreements with Stripe and/or Paddle, rate cards and settlement schedules, AML risk self-assessment, expected annual throughput and jurisdiction breakdown, standard end-customer licensing terms, and documented sanctions and transaction-monitoring procedures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound dividends, royalties, or shareholder-loan repayments to non-EU shareholders triggering enhanced due diligence under the 4th EU AML Directive.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Transfer pricing documentation, intercompany and shareholder-loan agreements, board minutes authorising the distribution or repayment, corporate and tax residence certificates (attestation de résidence fiscale), CRS/FATCA declarations, and French form 2777 withholding filings with proof of payment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: IoT remote-access telemetry data flows flagged by the bank as data-export or reputational/cyber-risk concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: GDPR compliance pack (DPO appointment, register of processing activities, data-flow map), CNIL registration receipt, ISO 27001 certificate where applicable, and a written end-use assurance confirming the software is not supplied to sanctioned or embargoed end-users.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Share capital deposit: funds are wired by SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's bank to the SARL's blocked capital account (compte bloqué) at an ACPR-licensed credit institution, or placed with a notary or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations; the depositary issues the attestation de dépôt des fonds required for Kbis registration, and the block is released upon extraction of the Kbis. Shareholder loans and current accounts: SEPA Credit Transfer for EUR or SWIFT MT103 for non-EUR with OECD BPM6 purpose code 'K.1 Equity capital' or 'K.2.2 Other capital' and remittance information referencing the shareholder resolution. A monthly Banque de France EFI (liaison financière) declaration is mandatory once individual or cumulative cross-border flows reach EUR 15,000. Verification controls: beneficiary name must exactly match the SARL's IBAN title, the Kbis certificate must be filed with the bank, and source-of-funds evidence retained for AML inspection.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: EU supplier payments via SEPA Credit Transfer or SEPA Instant with structured creditor references; non-EU supplier and professional fees via SWIFT MT103 (single customer credit transfer) with BPM6 service-purpose code 'K.2.4.2.2 Other business services' and underlying invoices. SaaS platform settlements: Paddle (Merchant of Record) nets end-customer receipts and remits the residual to the SARL as platform/revenue-share fees, requiring an inbound MT103 or SEPA credit with a business-services purpose code; Stripe payouts settle multi-currency operating revenue to the operational account, reconciled monthly against platform settlement statements. Outbound licensing, dividends, or shareholder-loan repayments require SWIFT MT103 plus board minutes, intercompany agreements, form 2777 withholding certificates, and double-tax-treaty relief documentation. Documentary trade finance is available via Commercial Letters of Credit (UCP 600) or standby LCs where suppliers require bank payment undertakings.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable forward FX contracts (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, EUR/CHF) with ACPR-licensed counterparties
FX swaps (swap de change) for short-dated liquidity conversion
Cross-currency interest rate swaps for material intercompany or bank-financing exposures, EMIR-cleared where applicable
Vanilla FX options (call/put on EUR pairs) intermediated by an AMF-licensed investment firm

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in restricted non-convertible currencies (e.g., USD/CNY, USD/INR) where the SARL holds trade or platform exposure in those currencies; NDFs are not used for EUR pairs because the EUR is freely deliverable
FX spot transactions with tom-next rollover for routine conversion of Stripe and Paddle multi-currency settlement balances

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return and liasse fiscale (déclaration de résultats n°2065 with attachments)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year SARL: e-file by 15 May of the following year; non-calendar-year SARL: within three months of the fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic late-filing penalty of 5% to 10% of the tax due, statutory late-payment interest of 0.20% per month, potential additional fine for missing schedules; no strike-off effect

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of annual financial statements and management report (dépôt des comptes annuels et rapport de gestion)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés, filed through the INPI Guichet Unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within seven months from the balance-sheet date (e.g., 31 July for a 31 December fiscal year-end); one month after shareholder approval if approval occurs earlier
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative injunction and fine of up to €10,000 against the legal representative; possible coercive court-ordered penalty payment; after two consecutive years of non-filing, risk of administrative strike-off (radiation) from the RCS

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-owner record verification and, if applicable, updated declaration of beneficial owners (vérification annuelle des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via the INPI single portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Re-verification at least once per calendar year; any change in beneficial ownership must be filed within fifteen days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal penalty of up to €15,000 fine and one year imprisonment for the legal representative; RCS may refuse issuance of registration certificates and suspend registration effects

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: For a French SARL, appointment of a statutory auditor (Commissaire aux comptes) is mandatory when the company exceeds at least two of the following three thresholds at the financial year-end: total balance sheet > €4,000,000; net turnover excluding VAT > €8,000,000; average number of employees > 50. Voluntary audit may be elected below these thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général) for individual annual accounts; IFRS is permitted only for consolidated financial statements. Micro-entity SARL may file simplified financial statements under French statutory exemptions.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Once per calendar year, the SARL must verify the personal data of its beneficial owners, cross-checking the register of members and the share-transfer ledger. Any change in a qualifying ownership interest (over 25% of shares or voting rights) must be re-filed with the RCS within fifteen days. The annual verification does not require a separate government filing unless data has changed, but it must be evidenced by a dated internal certification kept in the corporate minute book.

stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions
